machines.name: Elevate CNC CO2 Laser 2x2
machines.description:
Elevate CNC CO2 Laser Series – Entry CO2 Laser Cutter/Engraver (2×2)

The CO2 Laser Series cuts and engraves wood, acrylic, leather, fabric, and other non-metals. A compact, sealed CO2 tube system built for makers, sign shops, and small production runs that need clean edges without the setup of a router.

Included Features

Sealed CO2 laser tube, air- and water-cooled

Enclosed cutting bed with safety interlocks

Red-dot pointer for job alignment

Honeycomb cutting bed

Exhaust fan and ducting included

Controlled by LightBurn-compatible laser control software

Working Area

X Axis: 24 in

Y Axis: 24 in

Z Axis Travel: 8 in

Performance

Laser Power: 60W

Engraving Speed: up to 400 mm/s

Electrical Requirements

110V single-phase

Standard household outlet

Warranty & Support

1-Year Limited Warranty

Remote technical support included

machines.name: Elevate CNC Fiber Laser Cutting 4x4
machines.description:
Elevate CNC Fiber Laser Series – Production Fiber Cutting Table (4×4)

The Fiber Laser Series cuts sheet metal — mild steel, stainless, aluminum, brass, and copper — with a clean, fast, no-contact cut. Built for metal fabricators who need precision without secondary finishing.

Included Features

Sealed fiber laser source, water-cooled

Welded steel frame with slat cutting bed

Automatic focus height control

Nitrogen/oxygen-assist gas system compatible

Exhaust and fume extraction ready

Controlled by Cypcut-compatible cutting control software

Working Area

X Axis: 48 in

Y Axis: 48 in

Performance

Laser Power: 1000W

Max Cutting Speed: up to 25,000 mm/min (material dependent)

Max Steel Cutting Thickness: 0.5 in (material dependent)

Electrical Requirements

220V three-phase

Dedicated 30A circuit required

Compressed air / assist gas required

Warranty & Support

1-Year Limited Warranty

Remote technical support included
